title: crate-jmap's chatPush implements the pre-fix draft: it filters 'encrypted' out of an entry
description:
Found 2026-11-23, immediately after fixing the draft (jmap-chat-spec
377bddb). Needs Mark's approval to fix: AGENTS.md requires asking before
any write to ~/PROJECT/crate-jmap, per write.

crate-jmap-chat-server/src/push.rs implements the TEXT AS IT WAS, which
this repo's review found unsatisfiable and which Mark then had corrected:

- line 296-297, the doc comment: "The entry holds exactly the fields in
  `cfg.properties`, or the default set when it is absent. §`ChatPushConfig`:
  'The `properties` list is authoritative...'" -- quoting the sentence
  that is now removed from the draft.
- line 396, the behaviour and the part that matters:
      entry.encrypted = entry.encrypted.take().filter(|_| wanted("encrypted"));
  so a client that does not name `encrypted` in `properties` gets an
  entry without it. That is exactly the hazard the draft fix removes: the
  client then cannot tell a `bodySnippet`, `hasMention` or
  `mentionScopes` absent BECAUSE THE MESSAGE IS ENCRYPTED from one it
  simply did not request, and `encrypted` is the field every other field
  is read against.
- lines 49 and 64 list "encrypted" in both the MUST-support set and the
  default set, which the corrected draft no longer does, since the field
  is unconditional.

PROPOSED FIX, small:
- Stop filtering `encrypted`: delete the line 396 filter so the field is
  always present.
- Remove "encrypted" from the MUST-support and default property lists,
  since it is no longer governed by `properties`.
- Update the doc comments at 296-297 and 301-303 to the new wording:
  `properties` is an upper bound, and a named field appears only where
  its own rules allow.

Worth doing before mimid wires itself to these functions (bead
mimid-1wgh.99), because mimid would otherwise ship the old behaviour and
the draft and the implementation would disagree in the one place that is
security-relevant.
notes: FIXED 2026-11-23 in crate-jmap commit 20ec225b, Mark approved the write. The filter at push.rs:396 is gone, so 'encrypted' is present in every entry; it is also out of the MUST-support and default property lists since it is no longer governed by 'properties'; and the doc comments now carry the corrected wording. Five tests moved to the new semantics: three gained 'encrypted' in their expected key sets, properties_message_id_only_gives_exactly_one_key became properties_names_one_field_and_encrypted_comes_anyway, and space_name_absent_for_group_even_when_requested kept its assertion with a note that it is the evidence the old wording could not account for -- it asks for spaceName and asserts absence, which 'exactly the requested fields' could never have described. jmap-chat-server: 113 of 113 with cargo exit 0; fmt, clippy, typos clean. mimid can now wire delivery to build_chat_message_push without shipping the behaviour the draft removed.
